injuries: a back spasm from lifting a sofa

cocomm.q: The commentator asks: 'What's going wrong for the lads today?'
a: "We're too narrow. Their full-backs are getting forward and nobody's tracking them."
"Honestly? The ref's useless and our left-back's slower than my nan."

cocomm.q: 'Their striker's having a great game. What do you make of him?'
a: "Clever movement. He drifts off the centre-half's shoulder, then attacks the near post."
"He's got two feet and he uses them."
"He's alright. My rival {RIVAL} reckons he's better than me. He's not."

cocomm.q: 'Penalty! Should it be given?'
a: "Clumsy from the defender. He's gone to ground too early. Fair decision."
"I'd want it if it was us."
"Robbery. The ref's been bought. Write that down."

cocomm.q: 'The keeper's come for that and missed it. Is he at fault?'
a: "He's got to stay on his line there. That cross was never his."
"Keepers are a different breed, aren't they?"
"He's got hands like two bags of sand. Always has."

cocomm.q: 'What's the gaffer saying at half-time, do you think?'
a: "He'll want them higher up the pitch. We're sitting too deep and inviting pressure."
"Knowing him? Shouting, mostly. Then a biscuit."

cocomm.q: 'How's the injury coming along?'
a: "Rehab's going well. I'm doing the boring work so I come back stronger."
"Day by day, Jim. Day by day."
"Honestly? I'm loving the time off. Daytime telly is unreal."

cocomm.q: 'That's a booking. Harsh?'
a: "He's been warned twice already. You can't keep doing that and expect the ref to ignore it."
"Harsh? He wants sending off. He's a menace in training as well."

cocomm.q: 'Who's been the best player on the pitch so far?'
a: "Our holding midfielder. Doesn't get the headlines, but nothing gets past him."
"Hard to pick one out. Lot of good performances."
"Me, and I'm up here in a headset."

cocomm.q: 'The fans are getting restless. Can you understand that?'
a: "Totally. They pay good money. The lads need to give them something to shout about."
"They should try playing. It's harder than shouting."

cocomm.q: 'There's talk of a big transfer for one of your team-mates. Heard anything?'
a: "That's between him and the club. He's focused on today, and so are we."
"Oh, he's off. He's already been looking at houses."

cocomm.q: 'The referee's had a busy afternoon. How's he doing?'
a: "Decent, actually. He's letting the game flow, which suits both sides."
"He's needed a guide dog since kick-off."

cocomm.q: 'Tactically, what would you change?'
a: "Push the wingers inside and let the full-backs overlap. Their midfield can't cover the width."
"Maybe a bit more of this, a bit less of that."
"Bring me on. Dodgy hamstring and all."

cocomm.q: 'Do you miss being out there?'
a: "Every minute. From up here you can see how much space there is. I'll use it when I'm back."
"Not really. It's warm up here and there are free sandwiches."

cocomm.q: 'Their goalkeeper looks nervous. Should your lot be shooting more?'
a: "Definitely. Anything low and on target, he's struggling to hold. Test him."
"You've got to be in it to win it."
"I've seen him in the players' lounge. Nervous is his natural state."

cocomm.q: 'Big save there! How good was that?'
a: "Top drawer. Great starting position, so he only needed one step."
"Lucky. It hit him. Watch the replay."

cocomm.q: 'What's the dressing room like at the moment?'
a: "Tight. We've had tough spells, but we stick together and the young lads keep us going."
"Someone keeps nicking yoghurts out of the fridge. It's tearing us apart."

cocomm.q: 'That's a substitution. Right call?'
a: "Yeah, he was on a yellow and they were targeting him. Smart management."
"Wrong player off. The gaffer's got that one badly wrong."

cocomm.q: 'Set pieces seem to be a problem today. Why?'
a: "We're marking zonally and they're overloading the near post. Somebody needs to attack the ball."
"Because our centre-half can't jump. Never could."

cocomm.q: 'A young lad's just come on for his debut. Any advice for him?'
a: "Keep it simple, get an early touch, and enjoy it. You only get one debut."
"Don't get too comfy, son. That's my shirt, really."

cocomm.q: 'Is the pitch causing problems?'
a: "It's sticky in the middle. You can see passes holding up. Longer balls might be the answer."
"The groundsman's let it go. It's basically a farm."

cocomm.q: 'What do you make of the atmosphere today?'
a: "Brilliant. When the fans are like this it's like having an extra player."

cocomm.q: 'Who's the joker in the dressing room?'
a: "Our kit man. He keeps everyone grounded, which matters more than people think."
"{RIVAL}, but not on purpose. He's a walking punchline."

cocomm.q: 'Goal-line clearance! Talk us through it.'
a: "Great awareness. He's tracked the run from halfway and read exactly where it was going."
"He only got there because he was jogging back for a breather."

cocomm.q: 'Would you like to be a manager one day?'
a: "Maybe. I'm already doing my coaching badges. I love the tactical side."
"I'd be better than ours, put it that way."

cocomm.q: 'There's been a bit of a scuffle. What's going on there?'
a: "Handbags, really. The ref will calm it down. Nobody wants to go down to ten men."
"Get stuck in! Somebody give him a slap!"

cocomm.q: 'How's their new signing getting on?'
a: "Neat and tidy, but our lads have worked out he doesn't like turning on his left."
"For that money I'd want him doing my ironing as well."

cocomm.q: 'Five minutes left. Hold on, or go for it?'
a: "Go for it, but smartly. Keep two back and get bodies in the box."
"It's in the lap of the gods now."
"I'd park the team bus in front of the goal. Literally. I'd drive it on."

cocomm.q: 'What's your diet like while you're injured?'
a: "Strict. Lots of protein, lots of veg. Healing starts in the kitchen."
"Takeaways and biscuits. Don't tell the nutritionist."

cocomm.q: 'Who was your hero growing up?'
a: "My grandad. He drove me to every game and never missed one."
"Me. I've always been my own hero."

cocomm.q: 'Penalty shout waved away! Was it one?'
a: "No, he's got the ball first. Our lad was looking for it."
"Never a penalty. Our lad dived. Embarrassing, really."

cocomm.q: 'Their manager's been very animated on the touchline. Distracting?'
a: "It's all noise. Good players block it out and focus on the next pass."
"He looks like he's been plugged into the mains."

cocomm.q: 'Should the fans be patient with this team?'
a: "Yes. We're young, we're learning, and we're getting better every week."
"Patience is a virtue, as they say."

cocomm.q: 'Nearly full-time. What's the headline in tomorrow's paper?'
a: "Hard-working performance, one or two lessons to learn. That's football."
"'Injured star outshines entire team from commentary box.'"

interview.journalist: Dame Fiona Bluntly (the nation's most feared interviewer)

questions.q: Let's start simply. Why should anyone believe you're sorry?
a: "Because I am. What I did was wrong and I let a lot of people down."
"Look, everyone makes mistakes, it's been blown out of proportion."

questions.q: Who exactly did you let down?
a: "My family. My teammates. The fans who bought my shirt. Kids who looked up to me."
"I'm working with a charity every week, and I've paid back what I can. I'll earn it back, slowly."
"I just want to focus on my football."
